decisions.reason: Connects the plugin’s top-level ESM import to the classic-script combo compile failure and explains the stock typert-registry entry is only the first awaited victim.
Describes bisection over insert rows, classic-script parsing of the offending bundle, and the required ModuleLoader factory wrapper with package id, host require for React, inject and apply exports.
Uses the apply error to explain parent-owned slot declaration and undefined apply order, and shows deferred ctx.slots.inject registration with registrant-owned fields only.
Explains the combo is assembled once at boot, edits need full host restart, Windows orphaned process trees may retain the port, and EADDRINUSE is not a packaging defect.
Proposes per-plugin classic-script validation with culprit attribution and an author checklist covering loader factory, host React, inject/apply, deferred slots, and restart cleanup.

caps.reason: The final advice rejects bare ESM, uses slots.inject, omits registrant kind/scope, and requires host restart rather than browser refresh only.
